# Persipica: full site summary

Persipica makes Pulse, a cloud web app (pulse.persipica.com) that measures how AI assistants and shopping agents recommend a brand and its products, keeps the evidence behind every result, and turns the gaps into fixes it checks on the next scan. Pulse is the only product.

## Who it is for

Online retailers and consumer brands first; also B2B software and services companies, and agencies that run several brands.

## How Pulse measures

A scan asks AI assistants real questions, the way shoppers or buyers would, and reads every answer. For each scan you choose from seven assistants: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and Grok using each one's own live web search, and Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode as they appear in Google search. Scans start with ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. A scan covers one brand. By default it asks 27 questions (9 to 45 can be set), three times each on every chat assistant and once on Google AI Overviews and AI Mode; with ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini that is 243 answers. It counts as one scan however many assistants or audiences it includes. Shopping agent runs have their own allowance: 300 a month on Professional and 1,500 on Business. Answers vary between asks, so Pulse asks repeatedly and reports each rate with its likely range (a 95% interval) and sample size. Every number opens the answers behind it, with the question, the assistant, how the answer was collected and the sources it cited.

## What Pulse shows

- Overview: mention rate in AI answers, how often shopping agents pick the brand, site readiness checks passed, and results by audience.
- Visibility: mention rate, answers with citations, share of voice and position among competitors, by assistant and over time.
- Audiences: simulated shoppers described by the brand. Questions are written in each audience's voice, with follow-ups; results show how often each audience is recommended the brand, the top competitor for that audience, share of the shelf, and price and stock accuracy. Audiences are simulated, not observed customers, and every attribute is labelled as client data, a public signal or an assumption.
- Products: catalogue imported from a Shopify store, a Google Merchant Center feed or a CSV. For each product: how often it is named per audience and assistant, the prices AI quoted compared with the catalogue, and the stores AI sent shoppers to.
- Shopping agents: agents run buying tasks. Results show how often each agent found, shortlisted and picked the brand and each competitor, and the reasons it chose someone else. Readiness checks whether agents and crawlers can read product pages, prices, stock, feeds and robots rules, and server logs show which AI crawlers visit.
- Prompts and demand: questions people ask AI in the category, ranked by opportunity; search data from Google Search Console, Semrush or Ahrefs can weight them.
- Competitors and sources: competitors recommended instead, alerts when that changes, and the sites the answers cite, split into owned, earned, community and review.
- Accuracy: wrong prices or stock, entity confusion with similarly named companies, and citations that don't support the claim.

## What Pulse does about it

- Actions: suggested fixes and the team's own, with owners and status; each action's lift is measured on the next scan.
- Content fixes: rewrites, FAQs and comparison pages drafted from the answers where the brand was missed; publish to WordPress, Webflow, Contentful or Sanity, or via a webhook.
- Scans and schedules; alerts by email and Slack when visibility drops, a competitor surges, answers start getting facts wrong or AI crawlers are blocked.
- Reports: per-scan reports, summaries, an executive view, impact on visits, conversions and revenue from imported GA4 and Search Console data, benchmarks, and branded read-only share links.
- Teams: client workspaces for agencies, team roles, single sign-on and SCIM, a security log, an API and an MCP server.

## Pricing

- Free, £0: 1 brand, 10 scans a month, 1 team member, measured on ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. No card needed; sign up at https://pulse.persipica.com/login?mode=register.
- Starter, £99 a month: 1 brand, 50 scans a month, up to 3 team members.
- Professional, £299 a month: 3 brands, 200 scans a month, up to 10 team members; adds shopping agents (300 runs a month), shopping visibility and prompt demand.
- Business, £599 a month: 10 brands, 1,000 scans a month, up to 15 team members; adds 1,500 agent runs a month, actions with measured lift, readiness and AI crawler visits, impact reporting and client workspaces.
- Enterprise, custom: unlimited brands, scans and team members; reports under your own brand; single sign-on and SCIM; dedicated support.

Every paid plan can use all seven assistants, and every plan keeps the evidence behind each result. A free grader at https://persipica.com/grader.html asks ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini one question and shows whether they mention a brand, with no account.
